card.name: Digits inside numbers before a space or fraction
card.fires_on: Mostly a digit in the middle of a number, just before a thousands-separating space, a fraction, or a decimal part. It also fires on a few small linking words before a number or drug name.

modes.label: Digit in a spaced number
modes.description: A digit partway through a large number written with a space as the thousands separator.
modes.example: is expected to reach 9<<2>> 000 tonnes by 1

modes.label: Digit before a fraction
modes.description: A digit in a measurement or dose that is followed by a fraction such as 1/4 or ½.

modes.label: Linking word before a subject
modes.description: A short word such as every, with, on or to right before a number or a drug name.

card.writes: It seems to suppress whitespace and blank-line tokens, so the next token is more likely to be a digit or a letter than a gap.
card.plain: It marks a digit in the middle of a number, where more number text must follow instead of a space or line break.
